adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb` with only a subclass assertion, so it indeed never exercises `Admin::EmbeddingController#show`/`#update`. In the controller, `update` simply re-renders the `@embedding` OpenStruct set by `fetch_embedding` and does not read params or persist anything (it is effectively a no-op endpoint). Also, the new `EmbeddingSerializer` uses `has_many :embeddable_hosts, embed: :ids`, but there is no spec in the diff that asserts the actual JSON shape for `/admin/customize/embedding` or that Ember consumes it correctly (beyond a generic store `_ids` hydration test using `color_ids`). This is a concrete, diff-grounded testing/coverage gap and potential design incompleteness, but not a strictly provable runtime bug from the diff alone because the UI appears to save hosts via `embeddable-host` records, not via `embedding.update`.
